debit.notes: PhoneBanking: 'Contact our Phone Banking numbers 1800 1600 or 1800 2600 (available nationwide)'; per the customer-care page IVR runs 24x7 and agents 8.00 am-8.00 pm, but 'Reporting loss of cards is an Agent assisted facility and is available 24 hours on all days'; charges may apply per tariff plan. International: 'For international assistance, call +9122 61606160' (customer-care page publishes the same line as +912261606160 for customers travelling abroad). App path: HDFC Bank MobileBanking app > menu > Pay > Cards > select the Debit Card > reason > block. NetBanking path: log in > 'Card' section > 'Debit Card' > 'Requests' > 'Debit Card Hotlisting' (the block page's 'Block Now' button links https://netbanking.hdfcbank.com/netbanking/). Also MyCards https://mycards.hdfcbank.com/ (registered mobile + OTP > 'Block Card'), WhatsApp banking 70700 22222 (register with customer-ID last 4 + OTP, then 'Block My Debit Card' under Debit Card Services), or branch form. No debit-card block email is published and no 1930 mention appears on the bank's pages; the bank states 'Phone numbers mentioned here are the only Customer Care numbers of HDFC Bank, which you should use'.
debit.sms: SMS 'Block DC <Last 4 digits of your Debit Card number>' to 7308080808 from your registered HDFC Bank mobile number (example: 'Block DC 1234')

credit.notes: Credit-card services run 24 hours on all days including Sundays and bank holidays. The credit-card customer-care page lists 'From outside India: +91 22 6160 6161' while the general customer-care page publishes '+912261606160' for customers travelling abroad (and '+91 22 6160 6160' for Imperia/Diners Black/Infinia customers) - both are bank-published overseas lines, so both are recorded. Dedicated BizBlack Metal Card line: 1800 266 3310. App path: MobileBanking app home > Pay > Credit Cards > select the card > Block. MyCards PWA: https://mycards.hdfc.bank.in > enter registered mobile# > Card control > Services > Security > Hotlist. EVA chatbot on www.hdfc.bank.in: Credit Card Service > Block Card. WhatsApp banking 70700 22222 > type 'Hotlist Card'. Email customerservices.cards@hdfcbank.com from your registered email for credit-card requests. Charges may apply per tariff plan; the bank states its published numbers are the only Customer Care numbers to use. No 1930 mention on the bank's pages.
credit.sms: SMS 'Block CC ****' on 7308080808 - **** = last 4 digits of card number

upi.notes: HDFC publishes no in-app MobileBanking or NetBanking UPI lock. Bank-side deactivation: 'banks do not facilitate the removal of UPI IDs directly from their mobile applications. If you wish to remove the IDs, visit your bank branch and submit a UPI deactivation request.' Fastest self-service freeze: deregister in your UPI app — 'Under settings, you will find the deregister option; click on it' and confirm; 'Once you confirm deregistration, your bank account will be unlinked from the UPI app' (re-linking later creates a new UPI ID). Unauthorised UPI transactions: 'To report any unauthorised Credit Card, Debit Card, NetBanking, or UPI transactions, please call 1800 258 6161' — have mobile number, Customer ID, account number, transaction date/time and amount ready. Compromised UPI account: 'quickly update your UPI PIN and contact your bank. You may also need to disable UPI transactions if necessary.' Partner-app customer care published by HDFC: Google Pay 1-800-419-0157, WhatsApp 1-800-212-8552, Mobikwik 011-61266390. No SMS/USSD (*99#) UPI block keyword published on HDFC pages. Current official app listings, verified live 2026-11-01 on the bank's MobileBanking app page: Android com.hdfcbank.android.now and iOS id6504402552 ('HDFC Bank App: Banking & Cards', seller HDFC Bank Ltd — the page publishes the /us/ form of the same listing; both fetched HTTP 200). The app itself offers no UPI freeze.
